description: A deeply conversational task teaching preschoolers how to count sea animals.

engage.description: Engage the student with sea animals.
engage.speech_start: Welcome to the deep sea. . Look at how many sea animals are there. . Can you find seahorses? . There are three of them.
engage.speech_middle: Let's count. . One. . Two. . Three. . Four. . Five.
engage.speech_end: . . Say OK if you are done.

explore.description: Explore the student with sea animals.
explore.speech_start: Look, a large group of seahorses and a small group of seahorses.
explore.speech_middle: A large group of octopus and a small group of octopus.
explore.speech_end: Very Good!! . . Say OK if you are done.

explain.description: Teach that sea animals can be counted.
explain.speech_start: One. . . Two. . . Three seahorses. . . Do you see them?
explain.speech_end: One. . . Two. . . Three. . . Four octopus. . . Do you see them? . . Say OK if you are done.

multiple_choices_speech.op1: Let's check this one. Just one octopus. Not enough.
multiple_choices_speech.op2: Look here. Two seahorses. But we need octopus.
multiple_choices_speech.op3: Look here. One. Two. Two octopus. Close, but not enough.
multiple_choices_speech.op4: Now look here. One. Two. Three. Four. Four octopus! This is the answer!

elaborate.correct_option_speech: Great job! Four octopus! Now your turn!

multiple_choices_speech.op2: Or this one. Is this it?
